description:
Reduce the window-to-wall ratio (WWR) on the south facade of the 4StoreyBuilding to meet prescriptive code requirements. You must locate all south-facing windows on the occupied floors (Ground, Middle, Top) and reduce their HEIGHT property to 3.5 feet. The WIDTH of the windows must remain unchanged. 

Target Zones:
- Ground Floor: South Zone (G.S11)
- Middle Floor: South Zone (M.S21)
- Top Floor: South Zone (T.S31)

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Building Shell module (Detailed Interface).
2. Locate the south-facing exterior walls in the component tree for each of the three zones listed above.
3. Change the HEIGHT of every window on these south walls to 3.5.
4. Ensure the WIDTH remains unchanged.
5. Run the full annual simulation to verify the model.
6. Save the project.

The starting model is the standard '4StoreyBuilding'.
